verdict.rationale: vLLM's PagedAttention docs describe efficient KV-cache memory management, and its parallelism (tensor/pipeline/data/expert/context) and multi-LoRA support imply configurable resource/memory allocation across concurrent model instances, corroborated by community notes on KV cache and continuous batching. However, there's no explicit documentation of a power-user-facing knob (e.g., per-instance memory fraction/utilization controls) for allocating context memory across multiple concurrent model instances. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-instance memory allocation parameters (e.g., gpu_memory_utilization), and hands-on evidence of multi-instance memory partitioning in practice.
